summary:
And seemingly, every new tool and data source makes the problem even worse, adding more complexity, more headcount, and more risk. Many of the most fun investing conversations are with traders and portfolio managers because
they live and breathe risk day in and day out. Of course, they are often risking other
people's money, but controlling real money in markets.
